entities.summary: Theobald Reinhold Freiherr von Oer was a German painter, illustrator and etcher. He is notable for his portraits, genre paintings and historic paintings. He is associated with the Düsseldorf school of painting. Theobald von Oer was a painters & sculptors from Stromberg (1807-10-09, Stromberg–1885-01-30). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
